item.title: Astrophysicists Puzzle over Webb's New Universe
item.description:
📝 ” Scientists look at two key factors that influence a black hole’s size: how massive a black hole “seed” was when it originated, and how quickly these seeds grew after that. ” Scientists have historically believed there’s a hard limit to how fast black holes can grow. The radiation that this “accretion disk” produces pushes back against more stuff flying in, preventing the black hole from consuming more.
🔗 Read more: https://www.quantamagazine.org/astrophysicists-puzzle-over-webbs-new-universe-20260702/
